name: Pisa
tagline: The Leaning Tower and a lively university town
summary: Pisa is famous for its Leaning Tower, part of the white-marble Piazza dei Miracoli. Beyond the tower, it's a lively university town on the Arno with Renaissance squares and an easy base for Lucca and the Tuscan coast.
seasonNote: Busy with day-trippers in summer; book tower slots ahead.
arrival: Pisa Airport is 5 minutes from the centre; trains from Florence take about an hour.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; keep coins for church lights and espresso bars.
foodTip: Cecina chickpea flatbread and Tuscan soups.
buyTip: Leather from Florence-style shops and Tuscan wine.
